state_rules.typed_absent: Required external owner, channel, bytes, signature or receipt is not supplied; do not synthesize a value.
state_rules.typed_absence: Normalized absence state: a required external fact, material, channel or verifier capability is unavailable within the declared observation/contract scope; maps only to terminal_deferred.
state_rules.invalid: Material is present but malformed, contradictory, foreign, expired, revoked, replayed or digest/signature-invalid; maps to fail_closed and never to terminal_deferred.
state_rules.unverified: Material bytes are available and structurally admissible, but external authority, trust, freshness, replay or independent review is not yet verified; maps to terminal_deferred/non_evidence.
state_rules.terminal_deferred: typed_absent admission state; no send, authority recheck, publication or gate credit.
state_rules.fail_closed: Malformed, contradictory, foreign, stale, revoked, replayed, ambiguous or digest-mismatched material; retain raw bytes and do not repair in place.
state_rules.non_evidence: TEST_ONLY fixture, local bookkeeping, system-store observation or local software pass; never external authority evidence.
state_rules.program_exception: Unexpected verifier/runtime fault; cannot promote or substitute for a security result.
state_rules.unknown: Unknown owner/channel/material fact; represent as typed_absent or unknown and do not infer from context.

common_contract.canonical_bytes: Exact received UTF-8 bytes; reject duplicate object keys, non-finite numbers, unsupported number forms and unknown fields before acceptance.
common_contract.hash_algorithm: SHA-256 over the exact canonical bytes named by each field.
common_contract.atomic_delivery: One ordered bundle EHP-01,EHP-02,EHP-03,EHP-04; packet-set acceptance is accepted_all or rejected_all, never partial.
common_contract.signature_binding: Each packet owner signs its canonical packet-owner preimage; channel receiver signs the set receipt; independent reviewer signs recomputed outcomes. No self-reference.
common_contract.receipt_binding: Receipts repeat request/bundle/packet digests, scope, replay fields and trusted time; local spool/CAS receipts are bookkeeping only.
common_contract.recovery_binding: Recovery requires a fresh identity tuple, fresh canonical bytes and fresh signatures/receipts; changed source, policy, trust or candidate rebuilds downstream identities.
forbidden_global_substitutes: local name, self-attestation or unsigned email/message
Windows/system trust-store enumeration or an unpinned certificate
TEST_ONLY fixture, unit test, local spool, CAS or local ledger receipt
OS clock, file mtime, Git time, unsigned timestamp or inferred freshness
historical R1/R2/R3 receipt, stale digest or unchanged prior candidate identity
screen/proxy/result summary in place of candidate-bound bytes
local Authenticode observation in place of signed publisher/download provenance
synthetic owner, endpoint, credential, key, signature, authority or candidate

required_signatures: external witness signature over identity package and candidate/request scope
required_receipts: independent reviewer receipt binding identity, scope and validity
items.recovery_condition: named external witness supplies a signed identity package and reviewer receipt; if owner/channel remains absent retain typed_absent/terminal_deferred.

items.owner: independent witness plus governance owner (external; currently typed_absent)
required_raw_bytes: independence basis and conflict disclosure bytes
required_signatures: distinct witness signature over independence statement
governance/reviewer signature over separation and conflict scope
items.recovery_condition: obtain a fresh signed disclosure from a distinct witness; any conflict or scope change invalidates the old receipt.

required_raw_bytes: root public-key or DER certificate bytes
required_signatures: root self-signature
external administrator signature over scoped root package
required_fields: root public key or DER bytes
items.recovery_condition: authority publishes a new externally pinned root package and fresh policy receipt; re-run path and revocation checks.

required_raw_bytes: ordered root/intermediate/leaf DER or PEM bytes
required_signatures: per-certificate issuer signatures
external chain publication signature
items.recovery_condition: PKI owner returns a complete chain with fresh issuer and revocation evidence; changed chain requires a new signed receipt.

items.owner: independent witness; trusted-time/PKI authorities for supporting evidence (external; currently typed_absent)
required_raw_bytes: fresh trusted-time and revocation response bytes
required_signatures: external leaf signature over canonical preimage
certificate-chain signatures
required_receipts: attestation acknowledgement bound to packet digest
items.recovery_condition: re-sign the exact canonical response with a valid external leaf and fresh time/revocation receipts; no local signature generation.

required_signatures: external signature over verifier/profile digests
items.recovery_condition: publish a versioned, hash-pinned verifier/profile and fresh review receipt; policy changes invalidate prior acceptance.

items.owner: source authority and independent attestor (external; currently typed_absent)
required_signatures: source authority signature over complete inventory
independent attestor signature over same candidate scope
items.recovery_condition: source authority supplies complete signed closure for the same candidate; any source change rebuilds all downstream identities.

required_signatures: channel-owner signature over the channel contract and pin
items.recovery_condition: channel owner publishes a verifiable contract and testable acknowledgement path; no request is sent before this.

required_signatures: channel signature over acknowledgement preimage
receiver signature over durable quarantine receipt
required_receipts: server receipt id and signed ack
items.recovery_condition: channel returns a fresh signed ack or signed rejection; retain raw response and never treat local spool receipt as authority.

required_signatures: authority signature over the complete same-candidate lineage
items.recovery_condition: authoritative party issues one complete same-candidate lineage package; rebuild downstream receipts after any edit.

required_signatures: root/package signature bound to project scope
items.recovery_condition: fresh out-of-band root and policy package; all dependent signatures must be revalidated.

required_signatures: issuer signature on every certificate
items.recovery_condition: replace with a complete valid chain and new receipt; partial chain remains fail_closed.

required_signatures: leaf signature over attestation preimage
issuer signatures through the pinned chain
items.recovery_condition: new qualified attestor supplies a valid leaf and signed scope; old receipts expire on revocation.

items.owner: contract and verifier owner (external; currently typed_absent)
required_signatures: profile-owner signature over profile digest
items.recovery_condition: publish a new versioned profile and re-sign all affected receipts.

required_signatures: external authority signature over receipt preimage
chain signatures for the signing key
items.recovery_condition: issue a fresh receipt over unchanged or explicitly rebound bytes; no byte mutation is repair-in-place.

required_signatures: verifier release/profile signature
independent reviewer signature over replay result
items.recovery_condition: provide a supported pinned verifier or classify as typed_absent/unsupported; never substitute local unit tests.
forbidden_substitutes: claimed exit code without raw receipt

required_raw_bytes: signed CRL or OCSP response bytes
required_signatures: CA/issuer signature over revocation response
items.recovery_condition: fresh signed CRL/OCSP package with valid issuer and window; changed serial/issuer requires a new receipt.

required_signatures: TSA signature over token and imprint
items.recovery_condition: obtain a fresh independently verifiable time token bound to exact bytes.

items.owner: protocol and replay-ledger owner (external; currently typed_absent)
required_signatures: ledger authentication tag/signature
protocol-policy signature
items.recovery_condition: new authorized request with fresh nonce under unchanged policy; key/policy change requires new anchor and receipt.

items.owner: source owners plus independent attestor (external; currently typed_absent)
required_raw_bytes: HEAD/tree and six source working-hash bytes
required_signatures: source-owner inventory signature
independent attestor signature over candidate binding
items.recovery_condition: fresh signed inventory and rebuild candidate/axis/G2/receipt identities after drift.

items.owner: attestor and governance owner (external; currently typed_absent)
required_signatures: distinct attestor signature over scope digest
governance signature over separation
items.recovery_condition: new distinct attestor signs a complete scope statement; expiry/conflict closes prior evidence.

required_signatures: authority signature over graph digest
per-edge or referenced evidence signatures
items.recovery_condition: return a complete signed graph for one candidate and rebuild all downstream hashes.

required_signatures: G2 authority signature over mapping digest
issuer/PKI signatures for profile and trust
items.recovery_condition: authority issues a fresh complete mapping; any policy/source change invalidates the old one.

items.owner: G1/G2/G3 axis owners plus independent authority (external; currently typed_absent)
required_raw_bytes: exact four named axis material bytes
required_signatures: per-axis external signature
independent authority signature over the four-axis set
items.recovery_condition: obtain all four externally issued materials as one bound set; missing one keeps the set typed_absent.

required_raw_bytes: imports, Project.toml/Manifest.toml, locale/timezone and redaction-ledger bytes
required_signatures: provider signature over environment closure
outer authority signature over expected context
items.recovery_condition: provider supplies complete candidate-bound closure; runtime/source/dependency drift requires rebind.

items.owner: binary publisher/distributor plus independent provenance reviewer (external; currently typed_absent)
required_raw_bytes: every binary exact bytes and path/version identity
build/container recipe and SPDX/CycloneDX SBOM component/edge bytes
required_signatures: publisher signature/key over binary subject
signed download receipt
independent provenance-review signature
required_fields: signed download receipt with origin/retrieval time
SPDX/CycloneDX SBOM refs and dependency edges
items.recovery_condition: provider returns complete signed provenance or marks unavailable; no binary may be claimed covered by local Authenticode/store observation.
